Reranking with return_documents flag to include document text

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	request := pkg.RerankRequest{
		Model:           `rerank-v3.5`,
		Query:           `What is Rust?`,
		ReturnDocuments: ptr(true),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Rerank(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
